attribute_policy: All source attributes retained in source-accountability; structural titles, n, note place/anchored, languages, rendition, page facsimile and reference labels/targets also map to readable TEI. Source navigation, progress, shorttitle, shownumber and HTML table presentation attributes remain exact accounting evidence.
metadata_policy: Selected work title is source-root title. Whole electronic header is source-accounted without inferring constituent translator allocation. Metadata review and human acceptance remain open.
root_title: Select Orations of Saint Gregory Nazianzen.
scope: Complete named subtree including its own title matter, prefaces, notes, tables and links; enclosing/sibling material is accounted outside readable projection.
text_policy: Exact parsed source text and tails, including replacement characters, retained without correction; division title attributes additionally appear as generated heads.
